subject: Decision playbook kickoff + security owner alignment
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@finovate.com>, Mike Gomez <mike.gomez@finovate.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Decision playbook kickoff + security owner alignment

Hi Sara / Mike — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum going: 

- Outcome from call: Finovate wants a short governance-ready "decision playbook" that maps roles, timeline, and procurement gates for a Q1 2027 pilot.
- Economic buyer: you mentioned the CFO may need final approval — can you confirm name/title (for our steering invite)?
- Security / legal: we don't yet have the security reviewer/contact. Mike, you noted procurement often assigns a security owner during scoping — can you share that person's contact or confirm who will take that on?
- Procurement timeline: you called out a mid-December procurement review. Please confirm whether that is an internal procurement committee or a vendor review board.

Attached is an initial draft of a one-page playbook (redwood_decision_playbook_draft_v1.pdf) that we used with a few other fintechs — it includes a proposed steering committee agenda and decision criteria (cost, latency SLOs, data isolation).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Sara — confirm economic buyer (name & email) and 2–3 execs you want on the steering invite by EOB Mon (11/9).
2) Mike — share procurement/security owner and any procurement packet requirements (PO terms, insurance thresholds, SOC 2 evidence) so we can include them in the playbook draft.
3) Ben / Karthik (internal) — I’ll loop you in to draft the steering invite and a short packet for procurement.

Available slots for a 30–45m steering kickoff: Tue 11/10 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 11/11 13:00–14:00 PT, Thu 11/12 09:00–10:00 PT. If those don't work, tell us preferred windows and we will adjust.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
redwood.com

From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@finovate.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Decision playbook kickoff + security owner alignment

Lauren — thanks for the clear notes and the draft. A few points from our side: 

- Economic buyer: confirmed — Tom Park (Tom.Park@finovate.com), CFO. He prefers to be briefed with the steering committee rather than separate 1:1s.
- Steering attendees: please include me (product lead), Tom (CFO), and Claire Hsu (Head of Ops). We'll add 1–2 folks from Customer Ops as optional attendees.
- Security owner / procurement: looping in Mike — he'll introduce Claire or our security reviewer. Mike, can you confirm if Claire will own security review or if we should expect someone from InfoSec (they usually come in for vendor security intake).
- Procurement timeline: mid-December sounds right for a vendor review packet; target for internal decision is prior to year-end.

Slot preference: Wed 11/11 13:00 PT works for Tom and me. Please send an invite with the packet items you need from procurement (insurance, SOC 2 verifier, data retention terms).

Sara
Sara Lewis
VP Product, Finovate Inc.
+1 617-555-0144

Hi all — forwarding the proposed invite details and a quick procurement checklist I put together. We attached steering_slots.ics with the three times Lauren proposed; Sara, I’ll go ahead and pencil in Wed 11/11 13:00 PT since that works for Finovate. Please reply if we should move it.

Procurement packet checklist (for procurement/security intake):
- SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) — summary + contact at auditor
- Data processing addendum (DPA) draft
- Standard commercial terms (redlines tracked) + insurance certificate
- Latency & availability SLOs (token metrics) + sample perf report
- Onboarding plan and pilot scope (2-week pilot, production-go criteria)

Action items: 
- Mike: share your security reviewer + any bespoke evidence requirements (e.g., encryption at rest proof).
- Sara: confirm Tom/Claire inclusion on the 11/11 invite.
- Karthik: can you prepare a 10-min tech overview slide deck focused on security controls and caching strategy for the kickoff?

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Sara / Tom / team — thanks for confirming Wed 11/11 13:00 PT. I’ll keep the tech brief tight and security-focused (10 minutes) and will include the following:

- Encryption / key management model we propose for the pilot (KMS options + customer-managed keys for Private deployments)
- Minimal pilot scope: read-only inference, log retention 30 days, no data egress by default
- Sample perf snapshot for 99th percentile latency at target token sizes
- Required artifacts: SOC 2 pointer, sample DPA clause, and onboarding steps (I’ll attach links in the calendar invite)

Lauren — I made a short checklist page in Confluence for the Finovate packet: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/FIN/Finovate+Decision+Playbook+Draft. I also updated the HubSpot deal with the steering meeting (see link in metadata).

If procurement has specific contract terms they expect to negotiate (vendor liability caps, indemnity language), please paste their standard PO or examples into the Confluence page so our legal ops can pre-check.

See you Wed —
Karthik Iyer
